name: Titanic
description: A small passenger-level dataset commonly used to demonstrate binary classification and exploratory data analysis, with passenger demographics, ticket and fare information, and survival outcomes. Intended for tutorials and education only; it is not a representative or production-grade benchmark.
citation: Dawson, R. J. MacG. (1995). The 'Unusual Episode' Data Revisited. Journal of Statistics Education, 3(3). https://doi.org/10.1080/10691898.1995.11910499
